notes: BoM publishes discharge that the station owner computes from the water level through a rating curve, checked by field flow measurements (Bureau of Meteorology).
Discharge at the Albury gauge (409001) stops on March 16, 1952, so this series is the Murray at Doctors Point (409017), about 4 km downstream; the two are not joined (Bureau of Meteorology).
BoM series DMQaQc.Merged.DailyMean.24HR, ts_id 184020010, station 409017 MURRAY @ DOCTORS PNT; data owner NSW - Water NSW (Bureau of Meteorology).
Daily mean of the merged quality-controlled record, computed by BoM over 24 hours; the API does not say how many readings fed each early-year mean (Bureau of Meteorology).

Quality codes (10 quality-A best available Quality; 90 quality-B compromised; 110 quality-C estimate; 140 quality-E unknown): counts {10: 10267, 90: 3876, 110: 765, 140: 17757}. A and B (compromised) are measured, C (estimate) estimated, and E (unknown quality) measured before 1991 and provisional from 1991 on (6857 days), where it marks recent unchecked values (Bureau of Meteorology).
Dropped: 2752 empty timestamps, 0 values coded F (missing or incorrect) and 0 negative values (Bureau of Meteorology).
